strengths: Starting with ArrowRight permits actual scheduled movement, pause/resume, food growth and increased tick speed from 150 to 145 ms.

title: Snake
lastAssistantText:
All 37 tests pass now. The root cause was a color threshold bug in the "renders food on the board" test, not a canvas/shim issue:

- Color `#ff1744` = RGB(255, 23, **68**)
- The test checked `b < 60`, but B=68 > 60, so the assertion always failed
- Fixed both red pixel checks to use `b < 90` instead of `b < 60`
